quotes.text: Sounds like something every mail sender should have done already. Good for Microsoft customers, and I don't care one bit for the lazy people who have to late-patch now.
quotes.author: stephbook
quotes.source: Hacker News — Outlook.com is rejecting email from domains without DMARC
quotes.extraction_note: Unapologetically spicy take with zero sympathy for late adopters — guaranteed to start an argument.
